title: Sequence frame 1: desert mountain vista with faint dark object at ridge line
description: Full-page color photograph from an FBI FD-302 exhibit sequence: a dusk-toned view from a brushy hilltop across chaparral-covered mountains, with a dry lake bed and distant ranges at left under a clear blue sky. A small faint dark smudge is visible at ridge level right of center, the first frame of a multi-image sequence of an unidentified object.
